name: Rerun Data X-Ray Search
description: Rerun a saved Data X-Ray search from its query asset and re-sync the imported file assets: new files are imported, changed files updated, and files that no longer match are retired (never deleted).

edge.description: Rerun a saved Data X-Ray search from its query asset and re-sync the imported file assets: new files are imported, changed files updated, and files that no longer match are retired (never deleted). Collibra Cloud + Edge edition: Data X-Ray is reached through an Edge HTTP connection.
